title: pvWriteOpenVDBWriter
body:
## pvWriteOpenVDBWriter

Explicit-export writer for OpenVDB (.vdb), the sparse volume format used by Houdini, Blender and film-style renderers. It accepts non-composite image data (volumes) or point sets (meshes or point clouds handled through their points); with EnableColoring it adds a colour channel, and with EnableAlpha an alpha channel, computed from a lookup table supplied through the export's LookupTable resource. The declared publication uses the exact contract, comparing ParaView's readback of the .vdb with the input. Use it to send simulation volumes to rendering tools; keep pvWriteXMLImageDataWriter for lossless analysis data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- An earlier Schemaxis catalogue check of this writer failed because the readback differed from the input; expect exact verification to fail and set a comparison and accepted losses that match what VDB keeps.
- EnableColoring needs a lookup table connected through resources (LookupTable) and the array to map named in ColorArrayName; otherwise no colour channel can be computed.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) failed on a small serial fixture with default options: the readback differed from the input; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the file in the receiving tool.

Native constructor: `OpenVDBWriter`. Identity: `writers/OpenVDBWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData","vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `LookupTable` | Connect upstream object to `LookupTable` | False | one object | `lookup-table` | `{"compatibility":"native-proxy-group","cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","rating":"unknown"},"nativeGroup":"lookup_tables"}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellDataArrays` | Select the cell data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ChooseArraysToWrite` | Explicitly choose which arrays to write. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ColorArrayName` | The array that will be used for saving color information when **Enable Coloring** is ON. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EdgeDataArrays` | Select the edge data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EnableAlpha` | Specify whether alpha channel information should be saved in the VDB file. If enabled, the data source's transfer function from the active view will be used. This property is disabled if EnableColoring isn't enabled. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `EnableColoring` | Specify whether color information should be saved in the VDB file. If enabled, the data source's array to color with from the active view will be used. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FieldDataArrays` | Select the field data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointDataArrays` | Select the point data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RowDataArrays` | Select the row data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VertexDataArrays` | Select the vertex data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "exact",
  "extensions": [
    "vdb"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {
    "DummyInput": "domain-only input (no native command)"
  },
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteOpenVDBWriter"
}
```
